Node.Text: Welcome to our tutorial section. What do you wish to know?

Generally <u><color=#ff0000>WpfDiagram</color></u> is a .NET component. It is used to create, modify and present various kinds of flowchart diagrams, workflow processes, algorithms, entity-relationship diagrams and much more.
Have a nice day. Feel free to visit this section any time.

<u><color=#ff0000>WpfDiagram</color></u> exposes numerous advanced features. Among them is hierarchical grouping of objects, more than 60 predefined box shapes, table/grid objects with unlimited number of rows and columns, scrolling, zooming, printing, enhanced visual effects and many, many more.

Simply put, this is the ability to create groups of objects. One of the objects is considered a group master. Manipulating the group master will cause the other objects of the group to follow. So if you move the master, the attached objects move as well. You can attach masters themselves to other objects, thus creating whole hierarchies of attached grouped objects.
Using <u><color=#ff0000>WpfDiagram</color></u> you can easily add as much shapes to your document, as you like. Harness your imagination.
